quiz.question: The textbook defines AI primarily through the lens of the rational agent approach because it is:

options.B: More general and allows for rigorous mathematical analysis of behavior
options.C: Easier to implement than the "thinking humanly" approach
options.D: The only approach that uses neural networks

quiz.question: What is the defining property of an admissible heuristic h(n) in A* search?

options.A: It never overestimates the true cost to reach the goal
options.B: It always returns the exact remaining cost
options.C: It is always faster to compute than other heuristics

quiz.question: In CSPs, Arc Consistency (AC-3) is a form of inference that ensures:

options.A: Every variable has at least one value that satisfies the constraint with its neighbors

quiz.question: Unification is the fundamental inference operation that:

options.A: Finds a substitution to make two logical expressions identical
options.B: Calculates the probability of an event

quiz.question: Bayes' Rule is mathematically expressed as P(H|E) = P(E|H) * P(H) / P(E). It is used to:

options.A: Find the optimal path in a graph
options.B: Update prior beliefs based on new evidence (likelihood)

quiz.question: In a Markov Decision Process (MDP), the Bellman Equation recursively defines the value of a state as:

options.A: The immediate reward plus the discounted value of the best next state
options.B: The total number of actions taken
options.C: The probability of reaching the goal
options.D: The depth of the search tree

quiz.question: The EM (Expectation-Maximization) algorithm is specifically designed for:

options.A: Learning with completely observed data only
options.B: Maximum likelihood estimation when there are hidden (unobserved) variables

quiz.question: The fundamental trade-off in active Reinforcement Learning is:

options.B: Exploration (trying new actions) vs. Exploitation (using known good actions)

quiz.question: The Transformer architecture revolutionized NLP because it:

options.B: Uses the attention mechanism and processes sequences in parallel (no recurrence)

quiz.question: The Chinese Room argument (Searle) challenges the idea that:

options.B: Syntactic manipulation of symbols (which computers do) is sufficient for true understanding/consciousness
